component.name: Apache Guacamole
component.description: Clientless remote desktop gateway. The project's security page is a vulnerability-reporting policy and a catalog of fixed CVEs (with per-release details and analyses of non-applicable dependency CVEs such as Log4j and AngularJS issues); it does not describe a threat model, so this file records only the reporting scope.

externalReferences.comment: Source security page; this file is a structured translation of it.
